title: Wire layer outline mode toggle in Timeline and StageArea
description: outlineMode and outlineColor exist on the Layer model in packages/core/src/model/types.ts, and layer-visibility.ts has setLayerOutlineMode() — but nothing in the UI uses them. In Flash 8, clicking the colored square in the layer header toggled outline mode, and the stage showed all objects on that layer as colored outlines instead of filled shapes. Tasks: (1) In Timeline.tsx, add a clickable colored square (using layer.outlineColor or a default palette) to each layer row header that calls setLayerOutlineMode(); (2) In StageArea.tsx CanvasRenderer, when a layer has outlineMode=true, render its shapes as stroked outlines with the layer color instead of filled shapes.
